test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one among the following is NOT listed under 'Maharatna' companies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shipping Corporation of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The '**Maharatna**' status is granted to **Public Sector Enterprises** (PSEs) in India based on performance and financial health.
 
• Currently, 'Shipping Corporation of India' is not classified as a Maharatna company.
 
• Maharatna status enables greater autonomy and the ability to make decisions regarding **investments up to Rs. 5,000 crore without seeking government approval**.
 
• The Maharatna status is granted to companies like **Coal India Limited, Indian Oil Corporation, and National Thermal Power Corporation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharatna Companies**

 
 
• Maharatna companies are empowered to make investments up to Rs. 5,000 crore without government approval, enhancing their operational flexibility.
 
• Examples of Maharatna companies include Indian Oil Corporation, Coal India, NTPC, and ONGC.
 
• These companies contribute significantly to India’s economy in sectors like energy, coal mining, and petroleum.
 
 
 
• **Navratna and Miniratna Status**
 
 
• Navratna and Miniratna statuses are given to PSEs in India to encourage their performance and empower them in decision-making.
 
• While **Navratna **companies can make investments up to **Rs. 1,000 crore**, **Miniratna **companies have limited autonomy and can invest up to **Rs. 300 crore**.
 
 
 
• **Shipping Corporation of India (SCI)**
 
 
• SCI is one of India's largest shipping companies, primarily owned by the government.
 
• Despite its large contribution to the Indian economy, SCI does not currently hold Maharatna status.
